source: maplestory.io (GMS 270) — skillbook API + raw WZ API
notes: Frames listed with placeholder=true are 1x1 timing placeholders in the source WZ data; the player skips them.

skills.name: Supply Surplus
skills.description: Recharges 1 unit of power at set intervals, and gives you a chance to recharge on hit or evade. Also increases stats based on your current level of charge. This skill may use up power. Android Heart can also be equipped in the Power Source slot.

skills.name: Hybrid Logic
skills.description: Activates your Hybrid Logic routines to permanently increase all stats.

skills.name: Multilateral I
skills.description: Grants a special bonus based on stats, once those stats reach a certain threshold.

skills.name: Mimic Protocol
skills.description: Lets you ignore equipment stat requirements. Also lets you equip Pirate and Thief equipment.

skills.name: Promessa Escape
skills.description: Summons the Promessa to return to base.

skills.name: Modal Shift
skills.description: Activates the Modal Shift system, allowing you to alter the attack mode of your skills. Use this skill again to change back.

skills.name: Liberty Boosters
skills.description: Activate your internal boosters to fly for a short time. You can only use buff skills while airborne.

skills.name: Beam Dance
skills.description: Unleash a flurry with your Whip Blade to damage nearby enemies.

skills.name: Radial Nerve
skills.description: Enhances the cybernerve clusters in the lumbar vertebrae to enhance all movement.

skills.name: Multilateral II
skills.description: Grants a special bonus based on stats, once those stats reach a certain threshold.\nThe max HP/MP increases from Multilateral skills are multiplied after all other max HP/MP increases (excluding from those from Multilateral skills) are calculated. However, the max HP/MP increases from Multilateral skills are calculated as a sum.

skills.name: Beam Spline
skills.description: Lashes out with the Whip Blade twice to deals damage to multiple enemies.

skills.name: Propulsion Burst
skills.description: Momentarily accelerates Booster and jumps forward. Press the up key at the same to move upward.

skills.name: Circuit Surge
skills.description: Increases power output to increase damage.

skills.name: Salvo System
skills.description: Fires a rocket at enemies in range when landing an attack skill.\nRequires a short standby to fire when activated and you do not take damage even when attacking enemies with attack reflection.\nCan be turned On/Off

skills.name: Perspective Shift
skills.description: Increases Critical Rate by using scanners to find an enemy's weakness.

skills.name: Efficiency Streamline
skills.description: Maximizes energy efficiency to increase Max HP and MP.

skills.name: Xenon Boost
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Max HP/MP.

skills.name: Structural Integrity
skills.description: Increases All Stats.

skills.name: Xenon Mastery
skills.description: Increases Mastery and Attack Power.

skills.name: Multilateral III
skills.description: Grants a special bonus based on stats, once those stats reach a certain threshold.\nThe max HP/MP increases from Multilateral skills are multiplied after all other max HP/MP increases (excluding from those from Multilateral skills) are calculated. However, the max HP/MP increases from Multilateral skills are calculated as a sum.

skills.name: Salvo System Boost A
skills.description: Enhances Salvo System.

skills.name: Quicksilver: Flash
skills.description: Slashes several distant enemies with the Whip Blade. Change mode with Modal Shift.

skills.name: Ion Thrust
skills.description: Uses your Surplus Energy to deploy the Ion Thruster, which damages and pushes back enemies. Hold down the skill key to keep enemies at bay. Can be resisted by some monsters.

skills.name: Quicksilver: Concentrate
skills.description: Critically damages enemies with a penetrating stab of the Whip Blade. This attack has a higher Critical Rate than regular attacks. Change mode with Modal Shift.

skills.name: Quicksilver: Takeoff
skills.description: Swing the Whip Blade quickly and instantly activate the booster to jump. Can be used 1 time after using Propulsion Burst. Change mode with Modal Shift.

skills.name: Hybrid Defenses
skills.description: Additionally increases Avoidability and decreases Damage Taken.

skills.name: Triangulation
skills.description: Grants a chance to attach Airframes to enemies. Attached Airframes will reduce enemy Accuracy, and deal damage when an enemy with 3 attached Airframes is attacked. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Multilateral IV
skills.description: Grants a special bonus based on stats, once those stats reach a certain threshold.\nThe max HP/MP increases from Multilateral skills are multiplied after all other max HP/MP increases (excluding from those from Multilateral skills) are calculated. However, the max HP/MP increases from Multilateral skills are calculated as a sum.

skills.name: Salvo System Boost B
skills.description: Further enhances Salvo System.

skills.name: Combat Switch: Explosion
skills.description: Expands the Whip Blade and detonates its energy to damage several enemies. Change mode with Modal Shift.

skills.name: Diagonal Chase
skills.description: Activates full air boosters to shoot up with explosive power while pushing back enemies. Can be resisted by some enemies.\nCan be used during Gravity Pillar.

skills.name: Gravity Pillar
skills.description: Opens a field of anti-gravitational force to lift enemies into the air. Distant enemies are lifted even higher, and enemies in the energy field drop at a slower rate. Can be resisted by some enemies.

skills.name: Manifest Projector
skills.description: Create a projection of you that inflicts a portion of the damage you do. Your projection will disappear when it takes damage proportional to your HP or is hit with an attack that changes appearance or restricts movement. The projection cannot replicate the Salvo System, summoned monsters, 5th Job Common Skills, or certain other skills.

skills.name: Emergency Resupply
skills.description: Uses MP to recharge Surplus Energy supplies.

skills.name: Combat Switch: Air Whip
skills.description: Lashes diagonally with the Whip Blade to damage enemies in the air. Change mode with Modal Shift.

skills.name: Combat Switch: Fission
skills.description: Attacks enemies from above. Can be combined with Diagonal Chase. Change mode with Modal Shift.\nAttacks enemies in place after using upward Propulsion Burst.

skills.name: Horizon Driver
skills.description: Activates full air boosters to charge forward with an explosive attack.\nCan be used during Gravity Pillar.\nSP is not required for this skill, and it can be used if you learn the Diagonal Chase skill.

skills.name: Offensive Matrix
skills.description: Activates Offensive Matrix to ignore enemy defenses and knock-backs.

skills.name: Instant Shock
skills.description: Grants an additional evasion chance. The evasion bonus is added to Hybrid Defenses. Also increases the damage of Salvo System.

skills.name: Xenon Expert
skills.description: Increases Mastery, Attack Power, and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Multilateral V
skills.description: Grants a special bonus based on stats, once those stats reach a certain threshold.\nThe max HP/MP increases from Multilateral skills are multiplied after all other max HP/MP increases (excluding from those from Multilateral skills) are calculated. However, the max HP/MP increases from Multilateral skills are calculated as a sum.

skills.name: Salvo System Perfect Boost
skills.description: Maximizes Salvo System's performance.

skills.name: Multilateral VI
skills.description: Increases Final Damage permanently. Grants a special bonus based on stats, once those stats reach a certain threshold. Skill automatically acquired at Lv. 200.

skills.name: Beam Dance - Blur
skills.description: Increases the speed of Beam Dance.

skills.name: Beam Dance - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the attack power of Beam Dance.

skills.name: Beam Dance - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of monsters hit by Beam Dance.

skills.name: Mecha Purge - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Mecha Purge.

skills.name: Mecha Purge - Guard Break
skills.description: Increases the defense penetration of Mecha Purge.

skills.name: Mecha Purge - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of monsters hit by Mecha Purge: Bombard.

skills.name: Hypogram Field - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases Hypogram Field's attack count.

skills.name: Hypogram Field - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Hypogram Field.

skills.name: Hypogram Field - Persist
skills.description: Increases the duration of Hypogram Field.

skills.name: Beam Dance
skills.description: Unleash a flurry with your Whip Blade to damage nearby enemies.

skills.name: Mecha Purge: Snipe
skills.description: Roo-D scans for a critical weakness, then attacks with a high-tech sniper rifle to inflict severe damage to a single target. Attacks the enemy with the highest HP first. Use Modal Shift to change the attack mode.

skills.name: OOPArts Code
skills.description: Overrides safety protocols for a short time to increase damage and boss damage.

skills.name: Temporal Pod
skills.description: Launches a Temporal Pod that twists the flow of the time to quickly reduce the skill cooldowns of nearby party members. The pod will be destroyed when hit and has no effect on skills that are not affected by cooldown reset.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.\nCan be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Mecha Purge: Bombard
skills.description: Roo-D's tank fires a long-range shell to inflict damage over a large area. Change mode with Modal Shift.

skills.name: Mecha Purge: Bombardment
skills.description: Roo-D's bomber fires a barrage of missiles and lasers at enemies. Change mode with Modal Shift.

skills.name: Hypogram Field: Force Field
skills.description: Forms a Hypogram Field and generates an energy ball that deals damage on enemies inside the field. Hypogram Field: Force Field does not take damage, even when attacking enemies with attack reflection. Change mode with Modal Shift.

skills.name: Hypogram Field: Support
skills.description: Increases the Max HP of allies within the energy field. The power supply will recharge each time your allies successfully dodge an attack. Only active when Xenon is inside the field. Change mode with Modal Shift.

skills.name: Orbital Cataclysm
skills.description: Fires a powerful orbital laser cannon that can incinerate anything on the ground. Not affected by cooldown reduction effects.

skills.name: Entangling Lash
skills.description: Swings your energy sword at enemies in the direction you're facing to dispel some buffs, bind them, and stun them. Bound enemies cannot have buff effects applied for the duration of the stun.\nDebuffs: Attack Power/Magic ATT Increase, DEF Increase, Obsidian Skin.\nEnemies hit by this will resist stuns for 90 seconds and won't be stunned by other skills, like Entangling Lash.

skills.name: Amaranth Generator
skills.description: Activates the Amaranth Generator, which supplies you with infinite power for a short time.

skills.name: Omega Blaster
skills.description: Fires a powerful beam of energy. Can use buff skills that increases some stats after firing. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill.

skills.name: Core Overload
skills.description: Overloads your energy core, producing power in excess of your maximum storage capacity. Your skills will not cost any energy. Overloaded attacks produce plasma currents that strike nearby enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection. The increased capacity from overloading cannot be recharged by Amaranth Generator.

skills.name: Hypogram Field: Fusion
skills.description: Deploys the latest Hypogram Field that combines every Hypogram feature. If the area overlaps with the previously placed Hypogram Field, it's deployed after removing that Hypogram Field. Cannot deploy Hypogram Field if Hypogram Field: Fusion is already active. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Hypogram Field: Fusion
skills.description: Upon deploying Hypogram Field: Fusion, increases your damage and damage of party members within the field.

skills.name: Photon Ray
skills.description:
Lock onto enemies and destroy them with photonic cannon blasts.
Upon using the skill, temporarily enter aim mode and ready a chain of attacks, aiming several shots in sequence. Using the skill again will fire the photonic cannon at the most recently targeted enemy.
The initial fixed number of shots ends quickly. Additional shots, with a slow-moving cursor, produce one blast each. All shots prioritize Boss Monsters with the highest Max HP within range of the aim. Attacking an enemy that is being aimed at ends the aiming process quickly.
The aiming process is canceled if you either move away while aiming or move away from the last targeted enemy. If the aiming process ends before firing, every shot is canceled.
Unaffected by attack reflection. Manifest Projector does not apply to this skill. Can be fired without a firing motion while using Mecha Purge, Orbital Cataclysm, or Omega Blaster.

skills.name: Omega Blaster
skills.description: Fires a powerful beam of energy. Can use buff skills that increases some stats after firing.

skills.name: Core Overload
skills.description: Overloads your energy core, producing power in excess of your maximum storage capacity. Your skills will not cost any energy. Overloaded attacks produce plasma currents that strike nearby enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection. The increased capacity from overloading cannot be recharged by Amaranth Generator.

Energy condenses in the rifle periodically to trigger chain explosions quickly and execute the targeted enemy. Attacks the enemy with the highest Max HP first. Change modes with Modal Shift.

skills.name: HEXA Mecha Purge: Execute
skills.description: Roo-D scans the foe for a critical weakness, then attacks with a high-tech sniper rifle to inflict severe damage to the target, creating an explosion. Energy condenses in the rifle periodically to trigger chain explosions quickly and execute the targeted enemy. Attacks the enemy with the highest Max HP first. Change modes with Modal Shift.

skills.name: HEXA Mecha Purge: Bombardment
skills.description: Roo-D's bomber fires a barrage of missiles and lasers at enemies. Periodically triggers concentrated fire that completely devastates enemies in front of you. With Action Customization enabled, you can activate concentrated fire alone by pressing the skill key with the down arrow key.\nRight-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF

skills.name: HEXA Mecha Purge: Fire
skills.description: Roo-D's bomber fires a barrage of missiles and lasers at enemies. Periodically triggers concentrated fire that completely devastates enemies in front of you. skills.description: Fires a powerful orbital laser cannon that can incinerate anything on the ground. Not affected by cooldown reduction effects.

skills.name: HEXA Beam Dance

skills.name: Artificial Evolution
skills.description:
Achieves the Xenoroid's ultimate evolution. In its evolved state, it summons an enhanced airframe to attack enemies that Xenon attacks, enhances Liberty Boosters to increase flight speed, is able to use some attack skills while flying, decreases Liberty Boosters cooldown, and Omega Blaster is set up instantly whenever Omega Blaster triggers. The enhanced Liberty Boosters are canceled immediately when the evolved state ends. Liberty Boosters are triggered immediately after casting the skill, but they do not trigger when Action Customization is enabled.
Right-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +20%
Lv. 20 - Boss Damage: +20%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +30%, Boss Damage: +30%
